study: R9 recovered gen11 fixed diagnostic on reused2019–2025 benchmark

target_contract.prefix5: Contiguous observed finite actual-season WAR prefix up to5, discount0.85; actual season_end<=outer_year-1; no missing WAR zero fill.
target_contract.transform: Clip label value +/-40; within-cohort average-tied Gaussian rank (rank-.5)/n, clipped .01/.99. Refit normalization on each inner training subset.

selector.applies_to: TabICL only; Ridge and q25XGB use full panel
selector.fit_scope: each inner training subset and full outer training only, shared across three seeds

ridge.preprocessing: training mean and sample standard deviation(ddof1); zero std->1; standardized NaN->0, matching original honest.py Ridge; no missing indicators

inner_folds.assignment: int(SHA256(pid).hexdigest(),16)%3; selectors and target Gaussian ranks refitted inside each split

hybrid.query: pct_rank(full TabICL prediction)+mean(raw predictions from3 GPU q25 XGB bags)

coverage: Raw127 finite share, normalized/clipped with training q05/q95; thin iff normalized query coverage is strictly below query median. Fail if q05==q95.
seed_average: Primary fixed family_seed_rank_average: rank each family within each seed, average3 family ranks without re-ranking, then apply archived fixed rich/thin weights and rank the architecture. Per-seed/other architectures are diagnostics only.
limitations: Adapted fixed-weight mechanism, not an exact legacy257-feature gen11 replay. The same N127 panel replaces legacy features, shrinkage and engineering.
Deterministic PID-hash inner splits replace legacy rng3 shuffled splits; selectors and Gaussian targets are now fit inside each inner training split.
No age monotonic constraint on qualified127 predictors; XGB monotone constraints {} match K. No implicit old identity or age mapping.
Original TabICL default random_state42 is explicit; shifts101/202 intentionally test deterministic seeds. Batch_size8 and Latin feature permutation match original defaults.
Query labels, actual picks and scoring targets must be absent from worker namespace. No missing training WAR fabricatedzero.
2019–2025 is a historically reused benchmark, not a pristine holdout. No target, model, weight, feature or reporting-mode selection from these scores.
Verified actual NBA calendar currently ends2022:2024 and2025 omit later label seasons while retaining strict earlier-season cutoffs.
selection_authority: Recovered archived gen11 model identity and weights specified by parent before fitting; no selection from benchmark scores. Controls are diagnostics only.
prediction_freeze: All7 predictions and all protocol/source/constructor checks must freeze before any benchmark answers are opened by separate root scorer.
